// A fixture of listeners the check must refuse (RL-M2-006).
//
// Not a .go file, because it would not compile and because every one of these is a
// deliberate violation. Each is marked with the rule it must produce, so the fixture states
// its expectation and the test compares rather than counting — a count passes with the right
// total and the wrong lines.
package fixture

import (
	"crypto/tls"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"syscall"
)

func plainTCP() {
	net.Listen("tcp", ":9000") // want: network-listener
}

func everyFamilyByName() {
	net.ListenTCP("tcp", nil)            // want: network-listener
	net.ListenUDP("udp", nil)            // want: network-listener
	net.ListenIP("ip4:icmp", nil)        // want: network-listener
	net.ListenMulticastUDP("udp4", nil, nil) // want: network-listener
}

func theFamilyIsNamedInTheSecondArgument() {
	// The literal classifies the call wherever it sits, the same way shellcheck scans every
	// argument position rather than only the program — the bypass it found was
	// exec.Command("/usr/bin/env", "sh", ...), and this is the same shape.
	net.ListenPacket("udp6", "[::]:5353") // want: network-listener
}

func anHTTPServer() {
	http.ListenAndServe(":8080", nil)                    // want: network-listener
	http.ListenAndServeTLS(":8443", "c.pem", "k.pem", nil) // want: network-listener
}

func anHTTPServerStruct() {
	server := &http.Server{Addr: ":8080"}
	server.ListenAndServe() // want: network-listener
}

func tlsOverAnExistingListener() {
	var inner net.Listener
	tls.NewListener(inner, nil) // want: unclassified-listener
}

func aVariableNetwork() {
	// The gap shellcheck documents and cannot close, closed here: a listener whose family
	// is not visible in the source has to say what it is.
	network := "tcp"
	net.Listen(network, ":9000") // want: unclassified-listener
}

func socketActivationWithoutAReason() {
	var file *os.File
	net.FileListener(file) // want: unclassified-listener
}

func aBareAnnotationPermitsNothing() {
	network := "tcp"
	//ratline:allow-listener
	net.Listen(network, ":9000") // want: unclassified-listener
}

func aRawBind() {
	syscall.Bind(3, nil) // want: unclassified-listener
}
